domain_vision: Given an analytical intent and governed source facts, determine and retain the exact reproducible path from source cuts to analytical observations and, only through explicit authority, to business action.
sovereign_question: What meanings, contracts, transformations, analytical operations, policies, providers, and evidence are required to turn declared intent into trustworthy analytical output?
negative_charter: The platform does not infer business meaning from column names and present the inference as fact.
The platform does not allow analytics output to mutate a business aggregate directly.
The platform does not let connector, storage, compute, or vendor terminology own business semantics.
The platform does not call a plan compiled while required meaning, authority, or provider obligations remain unresolved.
The platform does not use one unqualified meaning of exactly-once, freshness, completeness, quality, dataset, event, or version.

strategic_subdomains.question: What does every domain and data product mean, and who owns that meaning?
Can declared analytical intent be resolved into a complete, valid, and explainable application closure?
Which domain-neutral analytical machines can operate on which semantic and structural contracts?
How may an analytical observation become a proposal, authorized command, and business fact?
How are source occurrences admitted, transformed, materialized, scheduled, and rebuilt?
What quality, provenance, use, disclosure, retention, and authority conditions govern data?
How is a verified plan deployed, executed, observed, recovered, and costed?
Which replaceable storage, compute, network, identity, secret, and scheduling facilities realize the plan?

bounded_contexts.name: Domain Specification
bounded_contexts.question: What vocabulary, entities, processes, rules, exclusions, and context mappings does a vertical domain own?
laws: One meaning per term inside one context
Context-specific concepts may share a real-world referent without sharing semantic identity
Every imported meaning names its sovereign owner

bounded_contexts.name: Measurement and Type Semantics
bounded_contexts.question: What reusable meanings do identifiers, quantities, units, rates, probabilities, scores, intervals, and missingness states have?
laws: Identifier is not number
Score is not probability
Currency is not bare decimal
Duration is not calendar interval
Null is not a missingness reason

bounded_contexts.name: Source Estate
bounded_contexts.question: What source system exists, who owns it, and what facts and change semantics can it authoritatively expose?
laws: A source capability is a claim with evidence, not a connector feature
A source occurrence retains its source identity and source cut

bounded_contexts.name: Provider and Connector Registry
bounded_contexts.question: Which replaceable provider implements a platform port, under which capabilities, limits, configuration, and conformance evidence?
laws: Providers implement ports but do not own meaning
Secrets are references and never domain-pack values
Provider errors are normalized at the adapter boundary

bounded_contexts.name: Data Contract
bounded_contexts.question: What values and occurrences may cross a data boundary, with which schema, semantics, quality, time, ownership, and service expectations?
laws: Every field separates carrier type from semantic type
Every dataset contract declares grain, keys, time, update, and finality semantics
Contract edition is separate from contract identity

bounded_contexts.name: Data Product and Asset
bounded_contexts.question: What governed logical data product is offered, and which immutable distributions, snapshots, and materializations realize it?
laws: Logical dataset, distribution, and immutable snapshot are distinct
Every published snapshot pins a source cut or derivation cut
Corrections create new history and never silently replace old meaning

bounded_contexts.name: Ingestion and Admission
bounded_contexts.question: How are hostile source carriers acquired and converted into admitted occurrences under a data contract?
laws: Raw carrier is not an admitted value
Admission retains raw provenance and exact source cursor
Late, duplicate, and out-of-order behavior is explicit

bounded_contexts.name: Transformation and Build
bounded_contexts.question: What deterministic derivation produces an output contract from exact input contracts and cuts?
laws: Every build pins code, configuration, input cuts, and output contract editions
SQL text is an implementation, not the portable logical plan
Batch and stream equivalence is either tested or explicitly disclaimed

bounded_contexts.name: Orchestration
bounded_contexts.question: When and in what dependency order should admitted work execute, retry, wait, cancel, or compensate?
laws: Workflow ordering does not own task meaning
Definition, run, task, and task instance are distinct
Retry policy must be compatible with effect idempotency

bounded_contexts.name: Quality and Fitness
bounded_contexts.question: Is a particular asset snapshot fit for a declared consumer purpose under a named quality policy?
laws: Quality is assessed against a named metric and purpose
Quality measurement is an observation and not a property silently embedded in the dataset
Freshness, completeness, accuracy, and finality are distinct

bounded_contexts.name: Provenance and Lineage
bounded_contexts.question: Which entities, activities, agents, cuts, code, configuration, and decisions caused an artifact to exist?
laws: Job definition and run occurrence are distinct
Lineage records derivation but does not prove statistical causality
Corrections preserve the original assertion and add a superseding assertion

bounded_contexts.name: Catalog and Discovery
bounded_contexts.question: What governed resources are discoverable to an actor, and which authoritative contexts own their descriptions?
laws: Catalog metadata is a projection and not the sovereign resource
Search visibility is filtered by disclosure policy
Catalog freshness is separately observable

bounded_contexts.name: Metric Semantics
bounded_contexts.question: What measure is computed over which population, grain, dimensions, filters, aggregation, and time semantics?
laws: Metric identity includes meaning, not query text
Every metric declares grain, population, time, filters, and aggregation
A rate is not a count and a score is not a probability

bounded_contexts.name: Analytics Machine Registry
bounded_contexts.question: Which domain-neutral analytical operation accepts which structures and semantic roles, under which assumptions, costs, and output contract?
laws: Horizontal machines refer only to abstract roles and semantic contracts
Every analytical output declares whether it is description, estimate, forecast, scenario, recommendation, or decision proposal
Analytical assumptions are explicit inputs to validity

bounded_contexts.name: Analytical Intent
bounded_contexts.question: What question, population, outcome, horizon, constraints, tolerances, decision proximity, and evidence does the requester declare?
laws: Intent states what is wanted and not how a vendor should implement it
Unknown semantic bindings become resolution tasks and never silent guesses

bounded_contexts.name: Composition Compiler
bounded_contexts.question: Can intent, domain meaning, data contracts, machines, policies, providers, and target capabilities close into one deterministic plan?
laws: Compilation succeeds only with semantic, contract, policy, provider, resource, and evidence closure
A closure retains every selection and satisfaction proof
The same normalized inputs and registry cuts produce the same closure digest

bounded_contexts.name: Runtime Execution
bounded_contexts.question: What actually executed from an approved plan, against which inputs and providers, with what outputs, receipts, checkpoints, and failures?
laws: Execution never invents missing semantic decisions
Exactly-once claims name their scope
End-to-end exactly-once requires replayable sources and transactional or idempotent sinks

bounded_contexts.name: Decision and Action Gateway
bounded_contexts.question: Under what authority may an analytical observation or proposal produce a command to a business bounded context?
laws: Analytical output is an observation or proposal and never a business fact
Every business mutation returns through the owning business aggregate
Approval records authority, evidence, policy edition, and decision time

bounded_contexts.name: Governance and Data Use
bounded_contexts.question: Who may use or disclose which data, for what purpose, jurisdiction, tenant, duration, and retained evidence?
laws: Use authority is scoped by subject, purpose, tenant, jurisdiction, and time
Revocation propagates to derived use obligations
Unavailable authority fails closed when policy requires it

bounded_contexts.name: Reliability and Economics
bounded_contexts.question: Did the platform meet declared service, resource, and cost obligations, and what degradation or remediation is required?
laws: Freshness, availability, quality, and finality are separate observations
Resource work is bounded and aggregate batch work is charged
Telemetry carries execution correlation and disclosure controls

bounded_contexts.name: Deployment and Control Plane
bounded_contexts.question: How is a verified lowered plan reconciled into desired and observed provider state with safe rollout and rollback?
laws: Control plane changes infrastructure state but never directly mutates business aggregates
Production boot rejects unsafe defaults
Desired and observed state remain distinct

platform_constitution.statement: Carrier type, semantic value type, observation role, analytical structure, and analytical use are separate axes.
Schema conformance does not establish semantic correctness.
A raw carrier becomes an admitted value only through explicit validation with retained provenance.
Every data asset snapshot has immutable identity and pins its contract edition and exact source or derivation cut.
Corrections, retractions, supersession, deletion, and recall are explicit and never silent overwrite.
Every transformation pins code, configuration, input cuts, output contract, and deterministic assumptions.
Lineage demonstrates derivation, not statistical or business causality.
Quality is an assessment of a named snapshot against a named metric and purpose.
Every metric declares measure, population, grain, dimensions, filters, aggregation, and time semantics.
Every analytical machine declares typed ports, assumptions, output epistemic status, determinism, and resource bounds.
Analytical observations and proposals cannot directly mutate business aggregates.
Compilation cannot succeed while a required semantic, contract, authority, provider, resource, or evidence obligation is unresolved.
Source systems, connectors, workflows, jobs, runs, datasets, distributions, snapshots, and catalog records are distinct concepts.
Exactly-once, freshness, completeness, and finality claims always name their scope and observation cut.
Provider-specific meaning cannot leak into semantic, ontology, data-contract, metric, or analytical-machine ownership.
Every data use is scoped by purpose, subject, tenant, jurisdiction, valid time, and authority evidence.
Revocation and recall create traceable downstream obligations across derivation lineage.
No single complete boolean replaces the independent research, semantic, compiler, lowering, runtime, and independent-verification completion axes.

forbidden_equivalences: Rust ownership is not semantic ownership
Rust lifetime is not domain time
Cargo dependency is not a context-map relationship
Serde deserialization is not semantic admission
Async execution is not a saga
Type safety is not data truth
Successful compilation is not runtime success

research_alignment.adopt: Separate job, run, dataset, and extensible facets; strengthen with sovereign semantic and cut identities.
Entities, activities, agents, usage, generation, derivation, and attribution.
Separate logical dataset, distribution, data service, dataset series, and catalog record.
Separate quality metric, dimension, measurement, policy, annotation, and certificate; quality remains purpose-relative.
Contract fundamentals, schema, quality, ownership, SLA, infrastructure and extension sections; SSPEC adds stronger semantics and proof.
Immutable snapshots, atomic metadata commits, stable field identity, schema evolution, partition evolution, and time travel concepts.
Event time, watermarks, scoped checkpoint guarantees, replay, and explicit end-to-end source/sink requirements.
Correlated traces, metrics, logs, resources, contexts, and explicit semantic conventions for runtime evidence.
